We saw Remote workers and digital nomads aged 25-40 struggling with challenges that existing solutions couldn't solve. So we built something different—a platform rooted in simplicity, productivity, efficiency.

Every feature we ship, every decision we make, reflects our commitment to simplicity. We're not just building software; we're building a movement.
